messages:
Maya (PM): kicking off a quick sync — we need to finalize the 'giveback' plan for observability on the console launch. what's the minimal telemetry surface we can ship that still keeps product teams and support safe?
Anika (Eng): proposed minimal: 3 dashboards (ingest, latency p50/p95, errors by route), single-span tracing hooks on request entry/exit, and a cost-by-model report run daily.
Jorge (Observability): +1 but want sampling rules clarified. single-span traces are fine if we sample 1% for hosted and 10% for enterprise for first 2 weeks.
Kai (SRE): sampling ok, but we need a fallback for spikes — if queue backlog > 500, auto-disable trace exports to avoid overload.
Liam (Support): from support POV, errors-by-route + a quick link to recent traces is the biggest time-saver. dashboards should have a filter for customer_id.
Maya (PM): good. let's capture acceptance criteria: 1) dashboards render <2s for median queries, 2) traces link opens to the request context, 3) cost report is available in the console and downloadable as CSV.
Anika (Eng): noted. implementation asks: how heavy is CSV once we include token-level cost? might need hourly aggregation.
Jorge (Observability): do hourly aggregates with an option to roll up per-model/per-route. keep raw token-level for 7 days for customers on enterprise only.
Kai (SRE): can we add an emergency flag in telemetry config to disable non-critical exports? I can wire a feature-flag that flips with a single API call.
Maya (PM): yes, emergency flag required. also, product wants an explicit rollback criterion: if percentage of 5xx increases by >1.5x after deploy, we auto-revert observability exports.
Anika (Eng): that's doable. need to define 5xx baseline window (48h prior deploy?).
Liam (Support): baseline 48h sounds fine. also request a short runbook snippet in the console: "How to turn off exports" for on-call.
Jorge (Observability): I'll draft sampling rules + retention matrix. quick snippet of the sampling config we expect:
```
sampling: 
  hosted: 0.01
  enterprise: 0.10
  emergency_disable_threshold: backlog: 500
retention:
  raw_token_level: enterprise: 7d, hosted: 1d
  hourly_agg: 90d
```
Kai (SRE): added a note: tracing exporter should be async with bounded queue. if queue > 1000, drop traces and emit a metric telemetry.trace.dropped.
Maya (PM): timeline: ship minimal observability in alpha next sprint (2w), then a giveback step at +4w to add route-level cost breakdown and editable sampling.
Anika (Eng): I'll scope the alpha PR: dashboards + single-span traces + cost CSV endpoint. estimate 6 dev-days + 2 QA-days.
Liam (Support): can we have a small CTA in the console alpha: "Report missing telemetry" to collect customer asks?
Jorge (Observability): yes — add a lightweight feedback form that pings a channel. funnel will help prioritize which givebacks to accelerate.
Maya (PM): action items: Jorge draft sampling/retention doc (due EOD Wednesday), Anika create alpha PR and link to QA (due end of sprint), Kai add emergency feature-flag + metric, Liam wire CTA to #support-observability.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled for 2330116000 to staging (observability-alpha). see: https://go.re.redwood/deploys/2330116000
Maya (PM): thanks all. if anyone sees major tradeoffs we missed (privacy, perf, cost), flag here. otherwise we'll lock scope tomorrow morning. :rocket:
